title: Pullback comparison for global derived Hom
statement: For a morphism of schemes $h:T\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] and $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category], define the canonical pullback-induced map $R\operatorname{Hom}_S(P,Q)\to h_\Gamma^*R\operatorname{Hom}_T(Lh^*P,Lh^*Q)$ [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] [def-pc-derived-pullback], where $h_\Gamma^*$ is exact restriction of scalars along $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$. Pull back the internal-Hom evaluation, use the canonical pullback tensor comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison], transpose under tensor/internal-Hom [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] and the pullback/direct-image adjunction, and apply derived global sections with its canonical Leray comparison (the one used in [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction]). The restriction of scalars composition identification is the identity on modules; it identifies the two scalar paths in any commutative square. No arbitrary morphism is part of the input. The tensor/internal-Hom bijection is the pinned canonical family of [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection].

lean.statement: def schemeGlobalDerivedHom_pullback_comparison {S T : Scheme.{uP}} (h : T ⟶ S) (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory S) : (schemeGlobalDerivedHom S).obj (op P, Q) ⟶ (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction h).obj ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom T).obj (op ((derivedPullback h).obj P), (derivedPullback h).obj Q))
